scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @portfolio/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:worker -w @portfolio/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @portfolio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run test:unit -w @portfolio/api && npm run test -w @portfolio/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @portfolio/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
